# Vishal Kumar Sahu

> SEO & Organic Growth | Product Marketing Lead at TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest), a B2B software testing platform. Based in Noida, India.

SEO specialist with 3.5+ years at TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest). The work runs from technical SEO, keyword research, content and link building to GEO/AEO: making sure the brand is cited when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini for answers. The method is the same for both: use Google Search Console, Ahrefs and Semrush to find where demand is going unmet, then build pages that rank, get cited and convert.

Key facts:

- Role: Product Marketing Lead, TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest), July 2023 to present. Before that: Sales Trainee, Byju's, July 2022 to September 2022.
- SEO: ran SEO for the LambdaTest to TestMu AI rebrand, optimized 150+ blog articles, built 40+ new SEO pages, merged 118 thin pages into one hub, and narrowed 1,652 keywords from 19 competitor domains into 14 topic clusters and 40 quick wins.
- GEO/AEO: set up AI search tracking in Profound, where TestMu AI ranks 9th of 142 domains for citation share.
- Beyond SEO: reworked 100+ landing pages around campaign goals, took LambdaTest to #1 on Product Hunt, grew Google My Business and Pinterest to 10K+ monthly views, edits Coding Jag (a weekly developer newsletter), and handled a $1.3M influencer budget.
- Tools: Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), Ahrefs, Semrush, SE Ranking, Profound, WordPress, VS Code, Claude, Notion, Replit, Hootsuite, MeetAlfred, Google My Business, Product Hunt.
- Education: Bachelor of Commerce, BBMKU (2020); Professional Certification in Digital Marketing & Strategy, IIDE (December 2024); Digital Marketing, Kraftshala (May 2023). Basic knowledge of paid media: Google, Meta and LinkedIn Ads.
- Profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishal-sahu-a56526238 and GitHub https://github.com/sahuvishal395

## Case studies

- [SEO and AI search case studies](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo): Seven SEO and GEO/AEO case studies from TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest), with the numbers behind each.
- [SEO for the LambdaTest to TestMu AI rebrand](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#rebrand-seo-migration): Redirect maps, sitemap and robots.txt cleanup, Organization schema, and updated brand profiles on Wikidata, G2, LinkedIn and GitHub.
- [Getting cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini answers](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#ai-search-geo-aeo): Set up AI search tracking in Profound, where TestMu AI ranks 9th of 142 domains for citation share, and planned Quora answers around 139 threads that AI tools already cite.
- [Fixing indexation on templated pages at scale](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#templated-pages-indexation): Merged 118 thin Chrome version pages into one hub with 301s, and wrote content and schema for 51 free-tool pages that had launched with no body copy.
- [Technical audits across product, learning-hub and blog pages](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#technical-seo-audits): Audited pages in Search Console, Ahrefs and Semrush; fixed cannibalization, wrong canonicals, stray noindex tags and redirect chains.
- [Reclaiming backlinks after the domain move](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#backlink-reclamation): Audited 449 "cross browser testing" backlinks after the move, found 376 still pointing to old or wrong URLs, and started repointing them to the right pages on the new domain.
- [A keyword research pipeline across 19 competitors](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#keyword-research-pipeline): Collected keywords across 19 competitor domains and narrowed 1,652 keywords into 14 topic clusters and 40 quick wins.
- [Content that wins Position 0](https://www.vishalkumarsahu.com/seo#content-featured-snippets): Optimized 150+ blog articles and built 40+ new SEO pages, winning featured snippets (Position 0) for target queries.
